title: Northwind Foods <> Cheerio: renewal
source: Pre-recorded call replayed through the meeting-bot pipeline

segments.text: Hi Aman, hi Mohit, thanks for making time. Quick heads-up: this call is recorded and Cheerio's assistant takes notes for me, is that okay?
Sure, go ahead.
So the renewal is on 11 November. Before we talk pricing, I wanted to hear how the last quarter went for you.
Campaigns are fine, the Diwali broadcast did well. But the campaign report exports keep failing. For a month now we can't download the full report for the big broadcasts.
I'm sorry about that, I know you've raised it more than once.
Three times. Ritika used to pull those reports every Monday, and now my team rebuilds them by hand.
The other thing for us is login. Our agency team has twelve people on the inbox. Is SSO coming in December? Kabir mentioned December last time.
Let me be straight with you: SSO has moved to Q1. I don't want to promise December and miss it.
Okay. Q1 is fine if it's real. Can you put that in writing?
Yes, I'll confirm the Q1 timeline in writing this week.
Also, can we send carousel templates from the API? Our developer wants to push product carousels straight from Shopify.
Yes, that shipped in September. I'll send you the docs after the call.
Honestly, one of the platforms we looked at is quite a bit cheaper on the Pro plan.
Understood. Can I show you the revenue attribution from your Diwali campaigns before we talk numbers? Your abandoned-cart flow alone recovered about ₹6.2 lakh last quarter.
That would help.
Coming back to the exports, when will that actually be fixed?
Our engineer Dev owns that fix. I'll get you a fix date by Friday.
Okay, Friday works.
And on the renewal, I'll send a proposal with the Pro plan and the AI credits bundle by Wednesday.
Sounds good. Thanks, both.
Thanks Aman, thanks Mohit. Talk soon.
